llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads column C (Old ID) and column D (New 7 Digit ID) for rows 2-30, and cell E1 (column 5, row 1), matching all instruction requirements.
Metric sub-goal 1 correctly checks D == str(C).zfill(7) for all data rows, verifying 7-digit zero-padding.
Metric sub-goal 2 correctly uses expected.get('count_expected', 29) to check E1 value; since expected.type='rule', the framework passes the rules dict directly, so direct access is correct.
Partial credit (0.5+0.5) is logically consistent with the two-step instruction.
data_only=True ensures formula-computed values are read correctly from the saved xlsx file.
Both instruction requirements (zero-padded D column and customer count in E1) are fully covered by the evaluator.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: The getter hardcodes rows 2-30 (range(2, 31)). This is consistent with count_expected=29 but would silently miss data if the spreadsheet has rows beyond row 30. Consider reading rows dynamically up to the last non-empty row in column C for robustness.
